CollectionItemWatched: This item is marked as watched.
Confirm.Change: Do you want to save the the {name} item changes?
Confirm.CreateNewAccessToken: Do you want to create a new access token?
Confirm.CreateNewUserToken: Do you want to create a new user token? This operation will revoke all existing access tokens.
Confirm.Delete: Do you want to delete the {name} item?
Confirm.DeleteUser: Do you want to delete the user? The operation will irreversibly remove all associated data.
Confirm.ExternalRatingsRefresh: Do you want to refresh external ratings? This operation will reprocess all collection items and refresh IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, and Metacritic ratings from OMDb. That may take a while and you could reach the OMDb rate limit. Please do not refresh or close the page until the process is complete.
Confirm.ImageRefresh: Do you want to refresh images? This operation will reprocess all collection items and refresh the missing images. That may take a while and you could reach the OMDb rate limit. Please do not refresh or close the page until the process is complete.
Confirm.ImportCollectionData: Do you want to import this collection tracker export? This will replace your current collection data, tag management settings, watch later list, wishlist, series tracker, and related metadata. The imported file becomes your new base state.
Confirm.ImportTagManagementConflicts: Some imported tag management entries already exist. Do you want to overwrite matching entries? Cancel keeps existing entries and imports only new ones.
Confirm.MarkAllAsUnwatched: Do you want to mark all items as unwatched? This operation will remove the #watched tag from all items in your collection.
Confirm.MarkAllAsWatched: Do you want to mark all items as watched? This operation will add the #watched tag to all items in your collection.
Confirm.MarkAllEpisodesUnwatched: Do you want to mark all episodes as unwatched? This will clear the watched episode progress for this series.
Confirm.MarkAllEpisodesWatched: Do you want to mark all episodes as watched? This will mark every episode in every season as watched.
Confirm.RefreshSeriesMetadata: Do you want to refresh season metadata from OMDb? Existing manual changes will be replaced.
Confirm.RemoveSeriesMetadata: Do you want to remove season metadata and use the default season and episode options?
Confirm.RemoveShare: Do you want to remove this share?
Confirm.ResetTagManagement: Do you want to reset tag management to default? This operation will remove all custom tag colors and display rules.
Confirm.RevokeAccessToken: Do you want to revoke the selected access token?
Confirm.RevokeShare: Do you want to revoke this incoming share?
DragToClose: Drag down or press Enter to close

Message.AccessTokenCreated: Here is your new access token. Please copy it now, as it will not be displayed again.
Message.AccessTokenSettings: The access token settings allow you to configure the authentication tokens used by the application.
Message.AddFirstFavorite: Mark items as favorite to find them here quickly.
Message.AddFirstSeriesTracker: Add a series to track watched episodes.
Message.AddFirstWatchLater: Add a movie or series to watch later.
Message.AddFirstWishlist: Add a movie or series to your wishlist.
Message.AiSearch: This option uses local AI to provide search results based on the collection items content. It may take a few seconds or minutes to get the search results, but it can find relevant items even with typos or when the search query does not exactly match the item attributes.
Message.AnimatedBackground: Enable or disable animated background. This setting impacts your network usage because enabling this option will fill the background with poster images from your collection items.
Message.CollectionDataExport: Export your collection data to a JSON file. You can import it later to restore your collection.
Message.CollectionDataImport: Import a collection tracker export JSON file to replace your current collection tracker data. This overwrites the current collection, watch later list, wishlist, series tracker, tag management, and settings in this account. Your login, access tokens, and shares are kept.
Message.CollectionItemsByIMDbIdImport: Import collection library items from a JSON, Markdown, or text file. The server extracts IMDb IDs from the file, fetches item details from OMDb, adds them to your collection library, and skips IMDb IDs that are already in any of your lists. This does not import watch later, wishlist, favorites, series tracker metadata, or watched state.
Message.CollectionListDisplay: Choose which collection item metadata appears in the list view.
Message.CreateNewAccessToken: You can create a new access token to grant permissions to external applications.
Message.DefaultLibrary: Choose which library is selected by default when adding new collection items. Shared libraries are listed here only when you have permission to create items in them.
Message.EmptySelectTagsForChart: Please select at least one tag to display the chart.
Message.ExportImport: Use this section to export or import your collection data and tag management settings.
Message.ExportImportTagManagement: Export or import your tag management settings. This includes custom tag colors, weights, and display rules.
Message.FetchSeriesMetadata: Use OMDb season data to limit watched-up-to options. OMDb data may be inaccurate and can be refreshed or edited later.
Message.GlobalWatchStatus: Use this section to quickly set the watched status for all items in your collection.
Message.IMDbRatingFallback: When the selected rating source has no value for an item, show its IMDb rating instead.
Message.MarkingAllAsUnwatched: Marking all items as unwatched, please wait.
Message.MarkingAllAsWatched: Marking all items as watched, please wait.
Message.MissingImages: Image URLs and external ratings are sourced from OMDb. This page lets you refresh missing images and refresh IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, and Metacritic ratings for all collection items.
Message.NewCollectionItemSearch: Search using a title, IMDb ID, or IMDb URL.
Message.NewCollectionItemSearchHelpStart: Didn't find what you wanted? Search
Message.NewUserTokenCreated: Here is your new user token. Please copy it now, as it will not be displayed again.
Message.RefreshExternalRatings: Refreshing external ratings, please wait. This process may take a while and you could reach the OMDb rate limit. Please do not refresh or close the page until the process is complete.
Message.RefreshImages: Refreshing images, please wait. This process may take a while and you could reach the OMDb rate limit. Please do not refresh or close the page until the process is complete.
Message.SensitiveDataStorage: With local storage, your data will be retained after the session ends. In contrast, with session storage, the affected data will be deleted when the session concludes.
Message.SeriesMetadata: Season and episode counts can come from OMDb and may be inaccurate. If the collected data is not correct, adjust the series metadata here to control the season and episode options.
Message.SetSeasonMetadata: No season metadata found. Please set the season and episode counts manually.
Message.ShareSettings: Manage collection sharing with other users. Use your share code to let others share with you, or add their share code to grant them access to your collection with specific permissions.
Message.StorageSettings: The storage settings dictate the policies for using browser storage within the application.
Message.TagManagement: On this page you can set border colors for tags. These colors will be used in the collection overview and details view to make it easier to identify items with specific tags. The tags are automatically loaded from your collection, so you can start customizing them right away! You can also choose to use the tag color for the image border in the collection overview. This can help you quickly identify items with specific tags without having to read the tag labels. The weight determines the color usage order when multiple tags are applicable.
Message.Tags: Please use space for delimiting. Eg: #tag1 tag2 The generated collection item will contain a default #movie or #series type tag.
Message.UserSettings: The user settings allow you to make account-related changes. This includes actions such as changing the login token or deleting the account.
